versions.changelog: v1.0.7 - security round 3 (time window as a hard boundary): with a window selected (--today / --week) or the default 'today', every dimension (agent/model, tool, skill, daily trend, task) now aggregates in-window events only - out-of-window events are discarded before aggregation and no longer leak into the agent/model, tool or skill tables (previously only the session list and the daily trend were filtered). A session crossing the boundary is truncated to its in-window part. Running without a window flag now defaults to today instead of all history; full history requires the explicit --all flag, and --today/--week/--all are mutually exclusive. The report header prints the statistical boundary and the JSON meta block adds window / window_scoped / window_start / window_end. Docs (SKILL.md incl. frontmatter, README zh/en, DESIGN.md, manifest notes) state the same boundary. The bilingual hero caption from the earlier 1.0.7 branch is folded in. No change to computed statistics within a window.

v1.0.6 - second security round: (1) the resolved data directory is now redacted to its last two segments by default and the new --include-paths flag is required to show the full local path (with a sensitive-metadata warning), so the output scope matches the documented aggregate-only contract; (2) SKILL.md now declares a permissions block (read: session JSONL, write: none, network: none, environment: OPENCLAW_STATE only) plus a permission & output-field section listing the exact default fields, the 11 fields added by --include-sessions and the behaviour of --include-paths; (3) the hero SVG subtitle is now bilingual (Chinese + English); (4) README (zh/en), DESIGN.md and manifest notes document the redaction and the opt-in field lists. No change to the computed statistics.

v1.0.5 - security/docs alignment: the script no longer reads, computes or outputs any cost field (docs, report and JSON now match); JSON output is minimized to aggregated statistics by default and session-level detail requires the explicit --include-sessions flag (with a sensitive-metadata warning); the report header now prints the resolved data directory and the output scope; SKILL.md gained allowed-tools, explicit activation boundaries (never auto-runs, no background scanning, scheduling requires explicit user confirmation) and a language-policy statement; README (zh/en) gained a privacy & data-scope section; manifest.json gained a permissions block; all comments were removed from the hero SVG. No functional change to the statistics themselves.
v1.0.4 - brand promo link updated to https://www.xiaoyaosai.com/ (docs-only change: SKILL.md bilingual promo line; no behavior change).
Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

Version 1.0.2 of xiaoyaoclaw-usage-report

- No changes to files detected in this release.
- Functionality, documentation, and skill behavior remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Expanded documentation with installation, usage workflow, and security guarantees; now highlights full read-only and local-only operation.
- Clarified statistic methods, especially token calculation and aggregation safety.
- Added an assets/community-qr.png for documentation or community use.
- Improved cron and HEARTBEAT integration examples for automated daily reports.
- Removed the old skill-card.md and updated core files and READMEs for clarity.

xiaoyaoclaw-usage-report 1.0.0

- Initial release of the OpenClaw usage and performance reporting tool.
- Parses local session JSONL files to report on agent task durations, tool/skill/model usage, and token consumption—operates fully offline with zero dependencies.
- Primary metric is token usage; no cost calculations included.
- Supports filtering by agent, time window, tool usage, and skill usage, with flexible output options (including JSON).
- Designed for establishing usage baselines, optimizing application performance, and generating optional daily reports via cron or scheduled tasks.
